label: For "Court Document Classification and Redaction": Classify filings by type and suggest redactions of personal data required by court rules so clerks process documents faster and releases comply. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Redaction with no rule cited.
